findings.evidence: The added Mathlib module declares finite-adele norm/product-formula results, while every finite-adele name used here (`isCompact_integralFiniteAdeles`, `exists_forall_sub_algebraMap_mem_adicCompletionIntegers`, `integralEmbedding`, and componentwise-operation lemmas) is declared in `TauCeti/RingTheory/DedekindDomain/FiniteAdeleRing/Basic.lean`, transitively imported by `Adeles.Basic`.
findings.fix: Remove this import; retain the existing `Adeles.Basic` import, which already exposes the finite-adele definitions and all referenced local theorems.
findings.issue: `Mathlib.NumberTheory.NumberField.FiniteAdeleRing` is unused: this file uses no norm or product-formula API introduced there.

summary: The added Mathlib import is unrelated to the declarations in this module and unnecessarily broadens its public dependency surface.
